purpose: Diagnose why five fixed-step Reference requests failed the P2E16B route-validity gate even though their Stage-A coarse/refined Reference comparisons were valid. This is post-primary supporting adjudication and cannot change the RossFast boundary result, P2E14 thresholds, Stage-A authorization or P2E16B classifications.

diagnostic_scope.request_construction: identical to frozen P2E16B request construction

forbidden: reclassification of the already observed P2E16B route boundary
retroactive conversion of diagnosis into prospective primary evidence
decision_rule: Classify each Reference invalidity by the first failed frozen route-validity predicate. If an implementation/harness predicate rather than the Reference numerical solve caused invalidity, record it and do not silently repair the primary result. Any future recovery of cases 1220/1257 requires a separately preregistered Reference-only resolution step.
next_permitted_action: Implement and execute one Reference-only diagnostic harness for exactly these five frozen requests.
